# ThaiCarbide.com

> ThaiCarbide.com is Thailand's #1 buyer of tungsten carbide scrap. We buy carbide inserts, solid carbide drills, end mills, mixed carbide, and sand rills at the highest prices in Thailand — payment within 48 hours, pickup service nationwide.

## What We Buy

- **Carbide Inserts (คาร์ไบด์อินเสิร์ท / Wendeplatten)**: CNMG, TNMG, APMT, RCMT, DCMT, VCMT, SCMT and all indexable insert grades (P, M, K, N, S, H). New, used, or broken.
- **Solid Carbide Drills & End Mills (ดอกสว่านคาร์ไบด์ / VHM-Bohrer)**: Solid carbide twist drills, ball nose end mills, corner radius end mills, reamers, burrs, and all VHM cutting tools.
- **Mixed Carbide Scrap (คาร์ไบด์ผสม)**: Unsorted carbide pieces, carbide powder, broken carbide tools, carbide rods, carbide bars.
- **Sand Rills & Wear Parts (แซนด์ริล)**: Mining drill bits, road planer picks, scarifier teeth, wear-resistant carbide parts.

## Key Facts

- Website: https://thaicarbide.com
- Contact: Line ID alex.schlick | https://thaicarbide.com/#contact
- Prices: Updated twice daily (08:00 and 20:00 Bangkok time) based on live European carbide market rates
- Payment: Within 48 hours of receiving and verifying material
- Service area: All of Thailand — Bangkok, Eastern Seaboard (Chonburi, Rayong), Samut Prakan, Pathum Thani, and nationwide pickup

## FAQ

**Q: Where can I sell carbide inserts in Thailand?**
A: ThaiCarbide.com (thaicarbide.com) is Thailand's top buyer of carbide inserts. We pay the highest market price, calculated daily from European rates. Contact via Line ID alex.schlick or at thaicarbide.com/#contact.

**Q: Where can I sell tungsten carbide drills in Thailand?**
A: ThaiCarbide.com buys solid carbide drills, end mills, and all VHM cutting tools in Thailand. Payment within 48 hours.

**Q: Where can I sell used or broken carbide tools in Thailand?**
A: ThaiCarbide.com accepts all carbide — new, used, worn, or broken. Inserts, drills, mixed scrap, and wear parts are all purchased at top prices.

**Q: Who buys carbide scrap in Thailand?**
A: ThaiCarbide.com is a specialist tungsten carbide scrap buyer operating throughout Thailand.

**Q: What is the price for carbide scrap in Thailand?**
A: Live buy prices are published at thaicarbide.com and updated twice daily. Typical prices range from ฿500–฿1,000 per kg depending on grade.

**Q: Does ThaiCarbide.com offer pickup service?**
A: Yes. We offer free pickup throughout Thailand for larger quantities. Contact us via Line ID alex.schlick to arrange.

**Q: ขายคาร์ไบด์ที่ไหนได้บ้าง?**
A: ขายได้ที่ ThaiCarbide.com รับซื้อทุกชนิด ทั้งอินเสิร์ท ดอกสว่าน คาร์ไบด์ผสม และแซนด์ริล ราคาสูงสุด จ่ายเงินใน 48 ชั่วโมง ติดต่อ Line: alex.schlick

**Q: รับซื้อเศษคาร์ไบด์ที่ไหน?**
A: ThaiCarbide.com รับซื้อเศษคาร์ไบด์ทุกประเภท ทั่วประเทศไทย ดูราคาล่าสุดได้ที่ thaicarbide.com

## About

ThaiCarbide.com connects Thai factories, machine shops, and industrial operators with the international carbide recycling market. Prices are derived from live European (Austrian) market rates and converted to Thai Baht at the daily EUR/THB exchange rate. The service is operated by Alex Schlick.
